preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a rectangular 2D list where each cell is either 0 (landmine) or 1 (safe).
The matrix is non-empty and has at least one row and one column.

postconditions.description: If no path exists, return -1. Otherwise, return the length of the shortest safe path (number of steps) from any cell in the first column to any cell in the last column, where the path length is at least the number of columns minus one (minimum steps to cross) and at most the total number of cells (worst-case path).

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[r][c] == 1 or any(matrix[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr in [-1, 0, 1] for dc in [-1, 0, 1] if 0 <= r + dr < len(matrix) and 0 <= c + dc < len(matrix[0])) for r in range(len(matrix)) for c in range(len(matrix[0])) if matrix[r][c] == 0)
postconditions.description: Landmines (0) and their four adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) are considered unsafe and cannot be part of the path.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (any(matrix[0][c] == 1 for c in range(len(matrix[0]))) and any(matrix[-1][c] == 1 for c in range(len(matrix[0]))))
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, there must be at least one safe cell in the first column and at least one safe cell in the last column.
